title: Negative residual
statement:
A point has a residual of −3.5. What does that mean?

[_]{a}

choices: The point is an error in the data
The line over-predicted this point by 3.5
explanations: That would be a positive residual.
A residual is about one point, not the slope.

solution: Negative residual: the prediction was 3.5 too high.
